description: Comune di Poggibonsi publishes these complementary geotopographic layers: external access points and driveways, road surfaces and adjoining verges, cadastral building-use annotations, building volumetric units, building footprints, vehicle circulation and parking surfaces, minor structures, cycling surfaces, internal building access, pedestrian surfaces. Coverage is the municipality of Poggibonsi. The group contains 11 separately identified thematic components; ZIP and other format representations are retained within those components. Building footprints are explicitly related to volumetric units, and access classes describe entry to buildings. The cadastral annotations describe building use and are labelled for AI training; they do not stand for generic parcel boundaries. The native metadata lists Shapefile, GeoJSON, GML and KML distributions, plus RDF data, with WMS/WFS services. Package and distribution metadata declare CC BY 4.0. Metadata is publicly readable; file-use charges are not stated. Observation dates, positional accuracy, field completeness and current service operation remain unverified; catalogue timestamps describe metadata changes. No specific simulation application is documented, so no simulation method is assigned. Related municipal road or building resources may represent other classes or earlier publications; exact member identities are retained. No archive, feature collection, map or dataset body was read. An additional 2 broader archive packages cover Immobili e Antropizzazioni, Viabilità, Mobilità e Trasporti. These source-defined class hierarchies overlap the individual layers already listed; package counts do not establish additional disjoint classes. The accompanying RDF is catalogue metadata. Archive contents and feature equivalence remain unverified. The added land-consumption annotation records the year a parcel passes from the land cadastre to the building cadastre when construction occurs. This is a building-registration transition, not a verified construction-completion date. It complements the building-use annotations for the same municipality. Fresh native metadata dated 2026-10-09 states CC BY 4.0; metadata dates do not establish observation dates.
